title: Unit version identity
responsibility: Fingerprints a unit’s manifest, owned source, contract and runtime independently so changes can be attributed to the affected part.

inputs.name: componentVersion.manifest
inputs.description: This is the unit manifest, used as typed without validation: its `id` becomes the output `unit`, its `owns.source` paths choose which `files` entries enter the `source` digest (the array is copied and sorted, never mutated), and the whole manifest, `contract` and `runtime` are each serialized with stableJson and hashed. The `manifest` digest covers the whole object, while `contract` and `runtime` digest only their own sub-objects, which is what lets a change be attributed to one part.

examples.title: Unit version identity
examples.responsibility: Fingerprints a unit’s manifest, owned source, contract and runtime independently so changes can be attributed to the affected part.

inputs.name: componentVersion.files
inputs.description: This is a map from repository-relative paths to content hashes, looked up only by the exact strings in `manifest.owns.source`, so entries for unowned paths are ignored. An owned path with a missing or empty `hash` is left out of both the output `files` and the `source` digest, and each hash is used as given without validation.

outputs.name: componentVersion
outputs.description: This identifies which version of a unit was observed, independent of any working tree: `unit` is the manifest `id`, and `manifest`, `source`, `contract` and `runtime` are lowercase 64-character hex SHA-256 digests of the canonical manifest, of the sorted owned paths and hashes, of the canonical contract and of the canonical runtime. `files` lists the owned paths that had a nonempty hash, in sorted order, and it is the same list the `source` digest covers.
